Everything you need to teach AP Networking, built and classroom ready

The complete teacher bundle for the College Board AP Career Kickstart networking pilot: all 22 topics across 4 units, authored to the official course framework. Decks, guides, tests, and answer keys are done, so your prep time goes to teaching instead of building.

What is included

  • 44 slide decks (14 slides each). Every topic ships a teacher edition with full speaker notes and answer reveals, plus a student edition with those stripped out.
  • 44 lesson guides. Teacher guides carry answer keys, facilitation notes, timing, and the misconceptions students actually hit. Student guides are un-keyed guided notes.
  • 4 unit tests with answer keys. 88 multiple choice questions and 8 free response prompts across the four units, every item tagged to its learning objective and essential knowledge statement.
  • 4 scenario performance tasks with scoring rubrics: the Device Recovery Walkthrough, the Lab Network Field Manual, the Game Day Network Blueprint, and the Incident Report and Resilience Plan.
  • Gradebook class management. Issue a class code, roster your students, set your own mastery threshold and retry policy, and watch scores land automatically as students work through the online lessons.

The four units

  • Unit 1, Managing My Connections. Troubleshooting, connecting and optimizing, and securing a personal device.
  • Unit 2, Managing My Shared Connections. Documenting, upgrading, and defending a small office or home network.
  • Unit 3, Managing Many Connections. Designing, segmenting, and filtering a multi segment LAN from scratch.
  • Unit 4, Managing Our Global Connections. Protocols and the OSI and TCP/IP models, the command line, routing, monitoring, and IPv6.

Interactive work your students actually use

All 22 topics include a browser based practice activity and an 8 question quiz. Both grade themselves and report to your gradebook, and both shuffle their cases and answer order every attempt, so no two runs are the same. Students isolate a fault on a topology strip, assemble an ordered firewall rule set with real first match behavior, read routing tables and traceroute output, and triage intrusion detection alerts.

On top of those, four full browser labs fill 26 periods of lab time: a device triage bench, a SOHO documentation and handoff, a segmented LAN build with routing and filtering, and a capture and trace investigation. Each runs a simulated network with a working command line, so ipconfig, ping, tracert, arp and nslookup all answer from a consistent model. Nothing to install, no networking hardware, works on a Chromebook.

Built for how the course is actually taught

Each unit opens with a real world scenario that its topics and performance task hang from. Every unit practices the AP Career Kickstart skills of connecting and configuring, securing, troubleshooting, and collaborating. Students use AI assistants and then verify the output by hand, which is a graded skill in this course rather than an afterthought.
